M1_Weed_Action_Repair.author: Kaito Fukami
M1_Weed_Action_Repair.trigger_condition: actor intended action in ('BUILD_PASTURE', 'PLANT') AND tile.kind == 'WEED'
action_sequence: turn t: replace intended action with ['DIG']
turn t+1: replay original intended action
turn t+2..t+1+N: replay tape actions offset by -1 turn for N steps (default N=8)
turn t+2+N: expire transaction, re-align to base policy
M1_Weed_Action_Repair.scope: Strictly local to blocked actor; market actions and unaffected actors untouched
M1_Weed_Action_Repair.reported_metric: Core component of public 3009.0 LB snapshot
M1_Weed_Action_Repair.promotion_eligibility: Direct candidate if natural blocker frequency > 0
